row.evidence: Slack's SCIM help article says SCIM provisioning is "Available on the Business+ and Enterprise plans", and the developer docs say "The SCIM API is only available to Slack workspaces on Business+ or Enterprise plans".
row.notes: Status, plans and prices unchanged since June: Pro $7.25 and Business+ $15 per user/month annual ($8.75 and $18 monthly; the page currently shows a 50%-off-for-3-months monthly promo). SAML SSO starts on Business+ (Pro has OAuth with Google only); Enterprise+ is Contact Sales and adds multi-SAML and SCIM for guests. New nuance: the SCIM help article says SCIM is also available on Free and Pro if a Salesforce org is connected to Slack. SCIM 1.1 and 2.0 at api.slack.com/scim, OAuth token with the admin scope; DELETE only deactivates (no permanent delete). Admin user-management Web API methods (admin.users.*, admin.roles.*) and the Audit Logs API are Enterprise-only.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: SCIM possible only with a connected Salesforce org.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: SSO is OAuth with Google only; SCIM only with a connected Salesforce org.

auth.token_source: Slack app with the admin OAuth scope, installed by an Owner/Admin (org install on Enterprise)

endpoints.notes: Reference lists GET /ServiceProviderConfigs, /ResourceTypes, /Schemas, /Users and /Groups (GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE).

deprovision.data_retained: Messages and files are not deleted; the user is removed from all channels.

custom.how: urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:slack:profile:2.0:User (e.g. profile.startDate) and custom profile fields, max 50; urn:scim:schemas:extension:slack:guest:2.0:User marks multi-channel guests

roles.how: Guest status via the slack:guest extension (multi-channel guests, Enterprise only); the roles attribute creates a profile field and does not set admin/owner roles (not documented as a role mapping).

rate_limits.text: Rate limited; HTTP 429 when limited (no numbers published on the SCIM pages).

limitations.text: Users cannot be permanently deleted, only deactivated.
Single-Channel Guests cannot be fully provisioned via SCIM.
Re-provisioning a duplicate email (even of a deactivated user) fails until the email is changed manually.
The Workspace Primary Owner cannot be deactivated.
Free and Pro get SCIM only when a Salesforce org is connected.

capabilities.notes: admin.users.remove removes a user from a workspace; deactivation is through SCIM. users.list (users:read) is a read-only Web API method on all plans.

endpoints.purpose: Invite a user to a workspace (Enterprise)
Assign an existing org user to a workspace
Remove a user from a workspace

rate_limits.text: Web API methods are tiered (admin.users.invite Tier 2, admin.users.list Tier 4).

okta.notes: OIN page checks SAML, SWA, SCIM, Create, Update, Deactivate, Group Push, Group Linking, Schema Discovery.

entra.notes: Microsoft tutorial covers Business+; Enterprise Grid customers follow Slack's instructions.

onelogin.notes: Slack lists OneLogin as a SCIM option but links to a OneLogin knowledge-base page that blocks bots; not verified.

fallbacks.other_sync: Live syncing of Active Directory groups via supported IdPs
